say:0:1511120001:0.text: This mural records how, ten thousand years ago, the deity worshipped by the Maulers' ancestors revealed his divine presence.
say:0:1511120001:0.source_cn: 这一卷记录的是万年前，蛮血先祖所崇拜的神明如何显圣。
say:0:1511120001:0.male: This mural records how, ten thousand years ago, the deity worshipped by the Maulers' ancestors revealed his divine presence.
say:0:1511120001:0.female: This mural records how, ten thousand years ago, the deity worshipped by the Maulers' ancestors revealed her divine presence.

say:1:1511120002:1.text: It is said that at the time, the Mauler tribes faced harsh natural conditions, relentless invasions, and devastating cataclysms.
say:1:1511120002:1.source_cn: 据说那时，蛮血部落面对着极端严苛的自然环境，外敌屡屡进...
say:1:1511120002:1.male: It is said that at the time, the Mauler tribes faced harsh natural conditions, relentless invasions, and devastating cataclysms.
say:1:1511120002:1.female: It is said that at the time, the Mauler tribes faced harsh natural conditions, relentless invasions, and devastating cataclysms.

say:2:1511120003:1.text: In answer to their prayers, their god descended from the heavens to walk the path of salvation... as Antandra once recounted to you.
say:2:1511120003:1.source_cn: 在先祖们的祝祷声中，蛮血的神明从天而降，以行救世之路…...
say:2:1511120003:1.male: In answer to their prayers, their god descended from the heavens to walk the path of salvation... as Antandra once recounted to you.
say:2:1511120003:1.female: In answer to their prayers, their god descended from the heavens to walk the path of salvation... as Antandra once recounted to you.

say:3:1511120004:1.text: A human who descended from the sky was devoutly worshiped by the Maulers—no, by the Wildborn. This mirrors exactly what you experienced when you traveled ten thousand years into the past.
say:3:1511120004:1.source_cn: 从天而降的人类，被蛮血……不，被雅库伯尔的兽人虔诚膜拜...
say:3:1511120004:1.male: A human who descended from the sky was devoutly worshiped by the Maulers—no, by the Wildborn. This mirrors exactly what you experienced when you traveled ten thousand years into the past.
say:3:1511120004:1.female: A human who descended from the sky was devoutly worshiped by the Maulers—no, by the Wildborn. This mirrors exactly what you experienced when you traveled ten thousand years into the past.

say:4:1511120005:1.text: You study the mural closely, examining the so-called "god" for anything that might resemble or differ from you.
say:4:1511120005:1.source_cn: 你仔细端详着壁画上的“神明”，试图从祂身上找到与你相似...
say:4:1511120005:1.male: You study the mural closely, examining the so-called "god" for anything that might resemble or differ from you.
say:4:1511120005:1.female: You study the mural closely, examining the so-called "goddess" for anything that might resemble or differ from you.

say:5:1511120006:1.text: Then you notice the crown. It's been heavily stylized, but even so, you recognize it. It's the same crown of honor the Wildborn offered you during the blessing ceremony.
say:5:1511120006:1.source_cn: 终于，你注意到了“神明”的头冠。它高度简化，但你依然可...
say:5:1511120006:1.male: Then you notice the crown. It's been heavily stylized, but even so, you recognize it. It's the same crown of honor the Wildborn offered you during the blessing ceremony.
say:5:1511120006:1.female: Then you notice the crown. It's been heavily stylized, but even so, you recognize it. It's the same crown of honor the Wildborn offered you during the blessing ceremony.

say:6:1511120007:1.text: Now you understand. <style="highlight">The "god" recorded on the Wanderer's Mural... is you.</style>
say:6:1511120007:1.male: Now you understand. <style="highlight">The "god" recorded on the Wanderer's Mural... is you.</style>
say:6:1511120007:1.female: Now you understand. <style="highlight">The "goddess" recorded on the Wanderer's Mural... is you.</style>
